name: once
description: Wraps a function so it executes only once, caching the first successful result and exposing reset state controls.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need idempotent lazy initialization or one-time setup logic (e.g., bootstrapping clients, singleton factories, attaching listeners) and want repeated calls to return the first computed result without rerunning side effects.

parameters.name: fn
parameters.description: Function to wrap so it runs only once.
